correctness.rationale: For k(s,t)=min(s,t)-st and noiseless two draws, integrated conditional Brownian-bridge variance is sum of three cubed gaps divided by 12, including ties. The exact quadratic functional S=6∫_{0<u<v<1}(v-u)(1-mu((u,v)))^2 du dv is convex; equality for zero-total signed perturbations fixes interior law. Proposed density 2(1+r²)/[1+(2x-1)²]^2 on central support, r+(1+r²)atan r=1, has constant potential on support and U=c+(3/2)dist² outside. This global Euler obstacle and convexity show unique minimizer among all Borel measures, excluding endpoint redistribution. Independent scipy quadrature verified normalization, potential at nine interior/exterior points, exact optimum 0.0160494871749149 versus uniform 0.025; these tests do not prove all-measure uniqueness. Supremum is inside expectation; no correlated-design conclusion.
